newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 130 bln bolivar TEM auction Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 130 bln bolivar TEM auction Tuesday.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Tuesday morning a 80 billion bolivar ($162 million) auction of 177-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills with a 19.54 percent coupon.
The bank said it would also offer 25 billion bolivars ($51 million) in 268-day bills with a 20.02 percent coupon, and another 25 billion bolivars of 357-day bills with a 20.50 percent coupon.
Some 40 billion bolivars of TEMs are due to mature on Thursday.
The auction comes a day earlier than the usual Wednesday slot due to Thursday's public holiday, which celebrates the birth of Simon Bolivar.
The weekly TEM bill auctions are the Central Bank's principal tool of monetary policy, used to restrict liquidity and establish a benchmark for wider interest rates.
